result.stdout:
UMK — Unity Modding Kit v0.1.4
A CLI-only, shell-driven project configurator and task runner for Unity mod development.

USAGE:
  umk init                  Run interactive configuration wizard to generate umk.json
  umk setup                 Reconfigure local game path & create libs\ junctions on clone
  umk upgrade               Upgrade umk.json format version to match installed UMK tool
  umk linkgamelibs          Link BepInEx, Unity, and game DLLs into .csproj via libs\ junctions
  umk <script>              Execute a named script from umk.json (e.g. build, run, clean)
  umk <script> --dry-run    Display resolved shell commands without executing them
  umk list                  Display available scripts and variables in umk.json
  umk help                  Display general help documentation
  umk help variables        Explain variable syntax and resolution
  umk help scripts          Explain script definitions and execution

OPTIONS:
  -n, --dry-run             Preview resolved commands without running them
  --ignore-umkv             Bypass UMK version mismatch check with umk.json
  -m, --manifest <path>     Use a specific manifest file instead of ./umk.json
  -v, --version             Display UMK version
  -h, --help                Display this help message
